title: Gold Rate Today Hyderabad: 22K Price Rises as 24K Drops
summary: On 27 July 2026 in Hyderabad, 10 grams of 22-carat gold rose to Rs. 1,33,700 (up Rs. 850) while 10 grams of 24-carat gold fell to Rs. 1,44,920 (down Rs. 10). Silver is quoted at Rs. 2,40,000 per kilogram. Prices are volatile due to international market movements, wedding-season demand and currency/import duty influences; buyers are advised to check live rates. Major jewelry hubs in the city include Panjagutta, Mehdipatnam, Tolichowki and Gulzar Houz.
content:
Hyderabad, July 25: Thegold rates today in Hyderabadrise on 27 July, 2026. Going by the rates today, the price of 10 grams of 22-carat gold isRs. 1,33,700with a rise of Rs. 850 while the rate of 10 grams of 24-carat gold isRs. 1,44,920with a fall of Rs. 10.

While the Silver rate is at Rs. 2,40,000 per kilogram.

Here To Join Us On WhatsApp

Thegold rates in the international markethave been fluctuating. Over the past few weeksgoldrateshave experienced a fall during the wedding season, fluctuating around Rs. 1,40,000 for 10 grams of 24-carat gold and approximately Rs. 1,50,000 for 10 grams of 22-carat gold.

Thegold pricesmentioned here are due at 8am, the prices could alter at every moment and hence the gold buyers need to track the live prices at a given time.

Most of the popular jewelry outlets are located inPanjagutta, Mehdipatnam, Tolichowki, Gulzar Houz in Hyderabad. Jewelry is also viewed as an investment that can be invested for short or long periods. Gold is also considered a mode of investment.

The investor can sell the gold at any point, and the return on investment is guaranteed and reliable. Gold in India tracks international gold prices, while the other two variables remain the rupee rates against the dollar and import duties levied by the government of India.

## Hyderabad, July 25

## Gold and Silver Rates — 27 July, 2026
- 10 grams of 22-carat gold: Rs. 1,33,700 (rise of Rs. 850)
- 10 grams of 24-carat gold: Rs. 1,44,920 (fall of Rs. 10)
- Silver: Rs. 2,40,000 per kilogram

Here To Join Us On WhatsApp

## Market Trends
The gold rates in the international market have been fluctuating. Over the past few weeks gold rates have experienced a fall during the wedding season, fluctuating around Rs. 1,40,000 for 10 grams of 24-carat gold and approximately Rs. 1,50,000 for 10 grams of 22-carat gold.

## Price Timing
The gold prices mentioned here are due at 8am; the prices could alter at every moment and hence the gold buyers need to track the live prices at a given time.

## Popular Jewelry Hubs in Hyderabad
Most of the popular jewelry outlets are located in:
- Panjagutta
- Mehdipatnam
- Tolichowki
- Gulzar Houz

## Gold as an Investment
Jewelry is also viewed as an investment that can be held for short or long periods. The investor can sell the gold at any point, and the return on investment is considered reliable. Gold in India tracks international gold prices, while the other two variables are the rupee rate against the dollar and import duties levied by the Government of India.
